text:
Emma: Quick triage — we need a compact runbook gating probe for GA tomorrow. Can owners call out a 1-line verification for: SLA docs, runbook (playbook steps), oncall coverage, monitoring alerts, and pricing smoke tests? Need sign-offs by EOD.

Raj: I can own model fallback + pricing smoke test. Will validate that fallback to the smaller quantized variant works and that cost flags trigger. Plan: small synthetic workload + verify billing meter.

Liam: SRE here — will own monitoring + oncall. Short checks I'll run:
- smoke traffic (10 qps) for 15m
- check latency P95 under 300ms for standard routes
- ensure alerting for 5% token error rate or 10% 5xxs
- confirm runbook play for failover to dedicated pool

Sofia: Docs ownership for the runbook/checklist. I will: add a compact troubleshooting table, paste the exact curl snippets, and a short TL;DR for support. Need expected error samples from eng so I can capture messages.

Emma: Good. Owners: Raj -> pricing+fallback, Liam -> monitoring+oncall, Sofia -> runbook/docs. I'll shepherd SLA doc edits (minor language) and coordinate legal signoffs if needed. @Raj @Liam @Sofia please drop a one-line ack when you start.

OpsBot: ticket created: PROJ-1234 "GA runbook gating probe" assigned to Emma, Raj, Liam, Sofia — due EOD.

Raj: Ack. Pricing smoke plan (quick):
```
# from oc cluster or k8s job
load-test --qps 10 --duration 15m --payload-size 256 --route /v1/generate
billing-check --last 30m --expect <10% spike
```

I'll post results and a small CSV of token counts.

Liam: Ack. Oncall notes: adding a one-pager with pager thresholds. Quick snippet I'll add to the runbook:
```
if error_rate(5xx, 5m) > 5% then page SRE-primary
if latency_p95 > 500ms after retries then page infra
fallback: switch routing -> dedicated-quantized for 10m, then revert
```

Sofia: Ack. I added a draft under /docs/runbooks/ga-gating.md and started a troubleshooting table. Raj — can you paste the two most common error strings you expect so I capture them verbatim?

Raj: sure — will paste in 10m. Also noting: include billing tag header X-Cost-Tag so finance can reconcile.

Emma: small ask re: SLA wording — keep the customer-facing SLA mention generic (uptime objective + exceptions). I'll push the edit and ping legal if they need to tweak.

Liam: Will run the burnin window at 15:00 UTC and drop the metrics here. If anything flakes we'll execute failover and record the timeline.

Sofia: Uploaded the runbook snapshot and a short checklist for support handoff. Link: internal://docs/runbooks/ga-gating.md (placeholder — I will update with real link).

Raj: Pricing smoke finished — no unexpected billing spikes, fallback exercised once and latency dropped ~30%. CSV uploaded to PROJ-1234.

Liam: Monitoring run complete. One transient spike at 15:07 — auto-fallback worked. I updated the runbook timeline and added remediation steps.

Emma: Great. Final asks: everyone add a :thumbsup: when you consider your item done. I will compile a single email to sales/support with the short TL;DR afterwards.

Raj: :thumbsup:

Liam: :thumbsup:

Sofia: :thumbsup:
